create_IterateOverBenchmarks: create a wrapper that iterates over a sequence of benchmarks on each reset call
create_CycleOverBenchmarks: create a wrapper that cycles through a list of benchmarks repeating once exhausted
create_CycleOverBenchmarksIterator: create a wrapper that uses a user-provided callback to generate benchmark iterators
create_RandomOrderBenchmarks: create a wrapper that selects benchmarks randomly from a list on each reset call
fork_IterateOverBenchmarks: fork an IterateOverBenchmarks wrapper to share or split the benchmark iterator independently
